# Closing the Procurement‑to‑Finance Gap: Introducing the Access Coins Evo + Kojo Integration

May 19, 2026

12pm EST / 9am PST

Register

Join **Access Coins Evo** and **Kojo** for a live walkthrough of the **new integration** designed specifically for specialty contractors. During the webinar, you'll see how field purchasing activity in Kojo flows seamlessly into your accounting and job costs in Coins, eliminating manual reconciliation, improving cost visibility, and accelerating month‑end close.

Plus, hear directly from **j** **oint customer Debbie Betts, Accountant at** **Anderson Howard,** on how connected field‑to‑finance workflows are helping her team stay in control of project costs.

This integration is available now for Coins and Kojo customers. **Register now** to attend live and learn more!

## Learn more about our hosts

![Access Coins Evo](https://assets-ext.bizzabo.com/bizzaboprod/image/upload/q_auto,f_auto,c_scale,c_crop,g_custom/v1775845550/oeulp5hfbaeos1wdbkgv)

Access Coins Evo is the complete construction ERP platform that unifies your entire business - financials, projects, service operations, field teams - giving you the control to protect margins and scale confidently.

[Learn about Coins](https://www.theaccessgroup.com/en-us/construction/products/coins/)

![](https://assets-ext.bizzabo.com/bizzaboprod/image/upload/q_auto,f_auto,c_scale,c_crop,g_custom/v1775845969/jwfnni1tssisgqdfl1xc)

Kojo is the leading materials procurement platform built for MEP contractors. Kojo connects the field, office, warehouse and accounting teams on one system, giving everyone visibility into what is being ordered, how much it costs and where it is going.

[Learn about Kojo](https://www.usekojo.com/)
